summary: A plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD) process using Cu(acac)2 and atomic hydrogen was developed for Cu seed applications in nanoscale semiconductor processing. The study investigated the integration of PEALD Cu with electroplated Cu for advanced interconnect applications, demonstrating void-free electroplated Cu on patterned via structures. The PEALD Cu process was shown to be a promising integration approach for sub-45 nm interconnect structures.
